impact: A steady software beat that eases fears AI is eating application software; limited direct effect on Clement's holdings.
summary: Workday's fiscal Q3 revenue rose 11.2% to $2.705 billion, slightly above the roughly $2.69 billion expected, and adjusted EPS was $2.82 vs $2.72. Subscription revenue grew 12.8% to $2.532 billion and the 12-month subscription backlog rose 12.3% to $9.216 billion. It raised fiscal 2027 subscription revenue guidance to $9.958 billion (13% growth) and said AI products added nearly $150 million in new annual contract value, more than triple a year ago.
title: Workday Q3 beats at $2.705B revenue, raises subscription guide to $9.958B
